raw.title: Customer Success Manager
raw.description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: https://retr.app/

About RETR

RETR is a mortgage market intelligence platform. Loan officers use us to find the real estate agents worth building relationships with, mortgage companies use us to recruit top producers, and lenders use us to decide who to lend their money through. More than 55% of the Top 100 mortgage lenders are customers.

We were founded in 2022, we are bootstrapped and profitable, and we have never taken outside money. We grew because loan officers told other loan officers about us. That word of mouth is the whole company in one sentence, and it is why customer outcomes are not a service function here. They are the growth engine.

We are fully remote and we operate on a few principles: lead with value, do the right thing, be generous without keeping score. We hire for honesty, integrity, fairness, accountability, and excellence, and we have very little appetite for process that does not earn its place.

The role

This is one of the first Customer Success Managers at RETR, and you will own a book of our enterprise customers end to end: the relationships, the value they get, the renewal, and the growth.

Our enterprise customers are held today by the founders, sales, support, and enablement, and they are held well. This role exists because the book has outgrown what any of them can carry alongside their own jobs. You get a defined set of accounts and the time to go deep on them: exactly how each one is doing, what it needs next, and where it should be a year from now.

You will report to our VP of Customer Advocacy and work alongside the account executives who own new business and large expansions, and the trainers who run onboarding and group sessions.

What you own

Four things. Everything else you do should move one of them.

A plan for every customer. A short written plan for every account in your book: why they bought, who the people are, what they are trying to accomplish, how they actually use the product, where the risk is, and what happens next. New accounts get one within 30 days. Plans get refreshed before every review and every renewal.

The renewal. You own the path to renewal from the day the account joins your book, not from 30 days out. Risk gets named early, in writing, with a plan against it. Nothing should churn without someone having seen it coming.

Expansion. Growth comes from value: new use cases, new features, new product lines, new teams and branches, and the seats that follow once people see what it is worth. You run the smaller expansions yourself and bring in an account executive on the larger ones. Part of your pay is tied to this, and it should feel like the natural result of doing the rest of the job well.

Advocates. Healthy customers become references, case studies, testimonials, referrals, and beta participants. In an industry this relationship-driven, a customer willing to vouch for us is worth more than most marketing we could buy.

Underneath those four, the work is: knowing how customers use RETR and helping them use it better, building relationships with executive sponsors and daily users alike, reading health from adoption and conversation rather than guessing, and bringing what you hear back into the company so the product and the experience get better.

What this role is not

It is not reactive account management, and it is not a job you win by holding a set number of calls a week. Calls matter, but what matters is what happens on them: the relationship built, the plan moved, the value shown, the joy created.

It is not a support queue. We have a support team and they are good. You are not the escalation path for every ticket in your book.

Because we are still building the Customer Advocacy function, you won't be stepping into a perfectly defined playbook. You'll help create it. We want someone who is energized by that.

How we work

RETR is intentionally lean. Automation before hiring, systems before managers, one to many before one to one. Technology and AI should absorb the work that does not need human judgment, so our people spend their time where people are worth the most: understanding a customer's business, solving a real problem, building a relationship, finding the opportunity nobody else saw.

So we do not want CSMs living in spreadsheets or doing repetitive admin. We want them thinking, and immersed/obsessed with our customers.

We are fully remote and async first. We write things down. We measure what you deliver, and in this role that is the health of your book.

What success looks like

A great CSM here can answer these about any account, at any moment, without opening a file:

  • Why did this customer buy RETR?
  • How are they using it today, and who actually uses it?
  • Are they getting value, and how do we know?
  • Who inside the organization cares, and who signs the renewal?
  • Where could we create more value for them?
  • What could cost us this renewal?
  • What happens next, and when?

In your first 30 days you will know your book: the renewals coming, the accounts at risk, and the people who matter in each. By 60 days every account has a plan and you have met the sponsors who count. By 90 days you are running the full scorecard, with your first expansions in motion.

Over a year, the work shows up as deeper adoption, earlier risk detection, stronger retention and expansion, and a list of customers willing to say so publicly. Most of all, our customers should feel that RETR understands their business and is invested in it.

What we're looking for

You are probably a strong fit if you:

  • Have 3+ years in customer success, account management, or another customer-facing SaaS role, owning a book with renewal or expansion targets.
  • Get genuinely curious about how a customer's business makes money, and can connect our product to the outcomes they care about.
  • Are comfortable owning the commercial health of an account, not just the relationship: the renewal, the risk, the growth.
  • Spot expansion that comes from real value, without turning every conversation into a pitch.
  • Notice problems early and act before anyone asks you to.
  • Move fast. Customers hear back from you quickly, and plans turn into action in days, not weeks.
  • Build relationships deep enough that customers want to vouch for you.
  • Use data, AI, and automation to decide where to focus, and save your own time for the conversations that need a person.
  • Communicate clearly with everyone from a daily user to a C-level executive.
  • Like building playbooks and doing well when the answer is not written down yet.
  • Are motivated by having part of your pay tied to keeping and growing your customers.
  • Work well with the account executives, support, and enablement people who share your accounts, and make them better at their jobs.
  • Get real energy out of a customer who is winning, and are not satisfied until they are.

Mortgage experience is a major plus. If you have worked in or sold into mortgage lending, whether at a lender, a broker, a vendor, a title or settlement company, or anywhere else in the ecosystem, say so clearly in your application. Our customers are loan officers, branch managers, and mortgage executives whose income moves with rates. Someone who already understands mortgage origination, recruiting, relationship building, and how a loan officer actually spends their day, starts contributing months earlier and earns credibility in the room on the first call.

It is a strong preference, not a requirement. Adjacent fintech, real estate, or proptech experience counts for a lot too, and we will take how you think and operate over a resume line every time.

Compensation and benefits

Base salary $85,000. On-target earnings $115,000, including $30,000 of variable at 100% of target, paid quarterly. Variable can reach 150% of target for strong performance, which puts total earnings around $130,000. Base is a national figure with no location adjustment.

Variable pay is tied to the two things this role exists to do:

  • Keeping customers. Retention across your book.
  • Growing customers. Expansion you lead, plus the larger expansions you help an account executive close.

You will see the full plan, including how each component pays out, before you accept an offer. We publish levels and bands internally, so you will always know your band and what the next level takes.

Benefits:

  • Medical premiums fully paid by RETR
  • Employer-provided dental, vision, life, and short and long-term disability
  • 401(k) with match: 100% of your first 1%, plus 50% of your next 5%
  • 15 days PTO plus 13 paid holidays, including Christmas Eve and the day after Thanksgiving
  • $100 weekly meal stipend and $100 monthly wellness stipend
  • $250 quarterly swag credit
  • Full home office setup: laptop, monitors, camera, and peripherals
  • Fully remote, and we fly the whole company together twice a year

How to apply

Email a resume to jobs@retr.app, with a few lines on one customer you kept, grew, or turned into an advocate, and what you actually did. Skip the cover letter.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/retr-customer-success-manager

raw.title: Lead Digital Marketing Manager
raw.description:
Headquarters: Remote US

Company Description

At Amwell, we’re transforming healthcare for all—powered by technology and inspired by people. Here, your ideas don’t just matter—they drive real change, improving lives on a global scale.

We marry technology and innovation with clinical excellence to provide trusted solutions that solve the healthcare industry’s biggest pain points and are on a mission to enable greater access to more convenient, affordable, and effective care.

We do this through our technology-enabled care platform that is designed to help our clients achieve their digital care ambitions – today and in the future. We offer programs spanning the full care continuum, including urgent, acute and specialty care, behavioral health, and services for the treatment of chronic conditions such as heart and cardiometabolic diseases. Programs are powered by Amwell as well as our growing partner network.

For almost two decades, Amwell has proudly served some of the largest and most sophisticated healthcare organizations in the U.S. and worldwide. Our team is passionate about technology’s role in transforming care delivery and making it more equitable, accessible, efficient, cost-effective and navigable for all.

Brief Overview 

This role owns Amwell's marketing web estate and how discoverable it is, across four properties: SilverCloud, business.amwell.com, patients.amwell.com, and LiveHealthOnline. Accountability covers performance and conversion on those properties, the compliance posture of what runs on them, and discoverability as search behavior shifts toward AI-generated answers.

The role directs work rather than performing all of it. Engineering owns development capacity and Design owns visual execution; this role defines, sequences, and holds the quality of the work both produce for the web estate. Page content and messaging remain with the pillar that owns each page, so this role owns the platform and its performance rather than what the pages say.

Core Responsibilities 

What the role owns:

• The four web properties — performance, conversion, and delivery

• Web compliance and governance, including cookie consent and tracking governance

• GEO and AI-answer discoverability across the properties, alongside conventional search performance

• Definition and sequencing of website build and development work delivered by Engineering

• Coordination with the separate Design team on visual work for the estate

• The web roadmap and the case for what it returns

How success is measured:

• Conversion performance across the four properties, and measured improvement in GEO and AI-answer discoverability (primary measurable output)

• Web property performance, including speed and core experience measures

• Tracking-compliance coverage across the estate

• Delivery of the web roadmap against plan

• Contribution of web to demand and engagement funnels

What the role does not own:

Scope boundaries are explicit, so accountability is single-owned and hand-offs are clean.

• Page content and messaging — each pillar owns what its own pages say

• Product application surfaces — Product

• Engineering development capacity itself — Engineering owns the resource; this role directs the work

• Visual design execution — the separate Design team

• Off-site authority and earned citations — Brand and Corporate Marketing with the external agency

• Paid media and demand strategy — Demand Generation Manager

Qualifications

• 7+ years in web, digital marketing, or growth, with direct ownership of a web estate

• A track record of moving a conversion measure on owned properties, not only of shipping site work

• Technical SEO depth, and demonstrated engagement with GEO and AI-answer discoverability

• Experience directing engineering delivery without owning the engineering resource

• Web compliance and tracking governance experience, including consent management

• Analytics fluency sufficient to defend what the web numbers claim

• The ability to hold a roadmap across competing stakeholder demands from multiple pillars

Preferred

• Healthcare or other regulated-industry web experience, including accessibility obligations

• Multi-property or multi-brand estate management

• CMS migration or replatforming experience

• Experience establishing GEO measurement where no baseline existed

Do Well. Live Well. At Amwell. 

Driven by our mission and values, we foster a workplace where Delivering Awesome, being Customer First and operating as One Team aren’t just aspirations – they are how we work, every day.  

Our people are our greatest asset. We strive to empower their growth and development not only as Amwellians but as individuals, through generous total rewards packages, a virtual-first work environment, work-life flexibility, including Summer Fridays and designated Mental Health Days, as well as opportunities to stretch and learn – to name a few. It’s our people who truly differentiate us. Ask anyone and they’ll tell you – you’ll never work with more passionate, more driven and more caring team members.    

We champion a culture of respect and inclusion, accountability and integrity, innovation and collaboration. At Amwell, you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career—improving healthcare for millions, growing alongside incredible teammates, and being valued for who you are.  

Benefits 

  • Flexible Personal Time Off (Vacation time)
  • 401K match
  • Competitive healthcare, dental and vision insurance plans
  • Paid Parental Leave (Maternity and Paternity leave)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program
  • Free access to Amwell’s Telehealth Services, SilverCloud and The Clinic by Cleveland Clinic’s second opinion program
  • Free Subscription to the Calm App
  • Tuition Assistance Program
  • Pet Insurance 

Salaried, Exempt Roles

The typical base salary range for this position is $121,950 - $149,050.  The actual salary offer will ultimately depend on multiple factors including, but not limited to, knowledge, skills, relevant education, experience, complexity or specialization of talent, and other objective factors.  In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for an annual bonus based on a combination of company performance and employee performance. Long-term incentive and short-term variable compensation may be offered as part of the compensation package dependent on the role. Some roles may be commission based, in which case the total compensation will be based on a commission, and the above range may not be an accurate representation of total compensation.

Further, the above range is subject to change based on market demands and operational needs and does not constitute a promise of a particular wage or a guarantee of employment. Your recruiter can share more during the hiring process about the specific salary range based on the above factors listed.

Fraud Prevention Notice

As part of Amwell's commitment to maintaining a secure and trusted hiring process, Amwell uses fraud detection capabilities within its hiring platform to help identify potentially suspicious, fraudulent, or unauthorized activity during the recruitment process.

These tools are designed to help protect candidates, Amwell, and the integrity of the hiring process by identifying indicators that may be associated with impersonation, account misuse, or other forms of recruiting fraud. Information generated through fraud detection is reviewed by authorized personnel and is not used as the sole basis for hiring decisions.

Personal information collected or processed in connection with fraud detection will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection laws and Amwell's Applicant Privacy Notice.

Identity Verification Notice

As part of Amwell's commitment to maintaining a secure and trusted hiring process, candidates for this role are required to complete an identity verification step through Greenhouse Identity Verification powered by CLEAR during the interview process. 

Identity verification is used solely to confirm a candidate's identity and help prevent fraud and impersonation within the hiring process. It is not a background check and does not independently determine hiring decisions. 

Because this role has been designated as requiring identity verification, completion of the verification process is a condition of continuing in the recruitment process. Candidates who do not complete the identity verification process will not be eligible to advance to subsequent stages of consideration for this role. 

Personal information collected as part of the identity verification process will be handled in accordance with applicable privacy laws and Amwell's Applicant Privacy Notice.

raw.title: Account Executive Product - Fraud & Risk
raw.description:
Headquarters: Chicago, Seattle, NYC, San Francisco, Remote

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Product Sales is a team of deep functional and technical specialists who both lead and advise on deals for the most strategically important products in Stripe’s portfolio. Stripe is investing in building out its Fraud & Risk Product Sales team and as an Account Executive you will be a critical part of the team driving the growth of this product.

What you’ll do

As an Account Executive, Product focusing on Fraud & Risk products, you will use your sales and product expertise to help drive product market fit & growth of Stripe’s fraud fighting products and solutions. You will collaborate with product, engineering and marketing teams to develop deep product and industry knowledge and drive strategic deals. You will be instrumental in leading in depth product discussions with existing and prospect users globally – and building and executing against our go to market strategy.

You are an adept salesperson, capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including CEOs, CTOs, and Chief Risk Officers. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding. You’re as comfortable working with clients as with internal stakeholders (including executives). You’re excited to become an expert and to share your knowledge. You’re an organized self-starter, an excellent communicator who is highly analytical and has a track record for improving the processes and organizations around you.

Responsibilities

  • Drive new business and revenue growth by selling Radar, Managed Risk, Dispute Resolution, and more, to a variety of businesses 
  • Lead complex new and expansion deals related to Stripe’s Fraud & Risk product offerings, capabilities, and tailored solutions
  • Deeply understand the sales process and what competitors offer in terms of fraud fighting capabilities, with a strong emphasis to overcoming competition to win all deals
  • Synthesize and relay customer feedback and findings to inform Stripe’s product roadmap
  • Engage with Product, Marketing and Account teams to help amplify our growth trajectory globally

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of customer facing experience at a leading technology or payments company and a track record of top performance, working specifically on enterprise or strategic accounts
  • Display a deep passion for fraud prevention and develop deep expertise 
  • A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners internally and externally
  • The ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment
  • Experience building trusted advisor relationships with senior business leaders
  • Self-starter capable of operating independently to drive meaningful business results
  • Ability to understand complex technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple stakeholders
  • Proven experience to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience specifically selling fraud solutions for payments to enterprise customers

raw.description:
Headquarters: Remote US

Company Description

At Amwell, we’re transforming healthcare for all—powered by technology and inspired by people. Here, your ideas don’t just matter—they drive real change, improving lives on a global scale.

We marry technology and innovation with clinical excellence to provide trusted solutions that solve the healthcare industry’s biggest pain points and are on a mission to enable greater access to more convenient, affordable, and effective care.

We do this through our technology-enabled care platform that is designed to help our clients achieve their digital care ambitions – today and in the future. We offer programs spanning the full care continuum, including urgent, acute and specialty care, behavioral health, and services for the treatment of chronic conditions such as heart and cardiometabolic diseases. Programs are powered by Amwell as well as our growing partner network.

For almost two decades, Amwell has proudly served some of the largest and most sophisticated healthcare organizations in the U.S. and worldwide. Our team is passionate about technology’s role in transforming care delivery and making it more equitable, accessible, efficient, cost-effective and navigable for all.

Brief Overview 

This role produces member-facing content across Amwell's service lines and is accountable for how that content performs once it reaches members. Content is a shared capability across the Engagement pillar: the account owners brief and approve, and this role produces at the volume and quality the book requires.

The role covers content strategy across service lines, the Engagement Hub content library, and the production of case studies and enablement assets that the account owners design. It also directs contractor and AI-assisted capacity, which is how volume is met with a single full-time position. Content engagement is a shared measure with the execution side, which owns timing and deliverability

Core Responsibilities 

What the role owns:

• Content strategy and production across service lines, the engagement showcase, and content libraries

• Inputting email content into the email CMS (Knak) — copy and image selection

• The Engagement Hub content library and its maintenance

• Case-study and enablement-asset production, against designs set by the account owners

• AI-assisted drafting and direction of contractor capacity for volume, within the approved content guidelines

• Brand-voice consistency across member-facing content

How success is measured:

• Content engagement across member-facing email and hub content, as the content contribution to open and click performance (primary measurable output)

• Content throughput and turnaround against briefs

• Brand-voice and quality consistency across the library

• Coverage of the service lines against the content plan

What the role does not own:

Scope boundaries are explicit so accountability is single-owned and hand-offs are clean.

• Campaign strategy or the customer relationship — the account owners

• The CMS platform itself, its branding rules, templates, and access — Manager, Campaign Production and Platform

• Campaign build, QA, and send — the campaign production team

• Timing and deliverability of sends, which share the engagement measure

• Foundational B2B content such as case studies, playbooks, and whitepapers — Commercialization

• PHI governance standards, which are set by Compliance

Qualifications

Required

• 5+ years producing consumer, member, or patient-facing content at volume

• Demonstrated ability to move a content engagement measure, not only to ship content on time

• Experience writing within regulated or clinically sensitive constraints, and the judgment to know when to route something to Compliance or Legal

• Experience directing freelance, agency, or contractor capacity against a brief

• Working fluency with AI-assisted drafting, and the editorial judgment to hold quality across it

• Comfort operating as shared capacity across competing internal demands

Preferred

• Healthcare, health plan, or behavioral health content experience

• Knak, Braze, or comparable content and email production platforms

• Accessibility standards for member communications

• Experience building or restructuring a content library

Do Well. Live Well. At Amwell. 

Driven by our mission and values, we foster a workplace where Delivering Awesome, being Customer First and operating as One Team aren’t just aspirations – they are how we work, every day.  

Our people are our greatest asset. We strive to empower their growth and development not only as Amwellians but as individuals, through generous total rewards packages, a virtual-first work environment, work-life flexibility, including Summer Fridays and designated Mental Health Days, as well as opportunities to stretch and learn – to name a few. It’s our people who truly differentiate us. Ask anyone and they’ll tell you – you’ll never work with more passionate, more driven and more caring team members.    

We champion a culture of respect and inclusion, accountability and integrity, innovation and collaboration. At Amwell, you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career—improving healthcare for millions, growing alongside incredible teammates, and being valued for who you are.  

Benefits 

  • Flexible Personal Time Off (Vacation time)
  • 401K match
  • Competitive healthcare, dental and vision insurance plans
  • Paid Parental Leave (Maternity and Paternity leave)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program
  • Free access to Amwell’s Telehealth Services, SilverCloud and The Clinic by Cleveland Clinic’s second opinion program
  • Free Subscription to the Calm App
  • Tuition Assistance Program
  • Pet Insurance 

Salaried, Exempt Roles

The typical base salary range for this position is $90,000 - $110,000.  The actual salary offer will ultimately depend on multiple factors including, but not limited to, knowledge, skills, relevant education, experience, complexity or specialization of talent, and other objective factors.  In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for an annual bonus based on a combination of company performance and employee performance. raw.title: Head of Design & Development & Construction
raw.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://gilbertpharmaceuticals.com/

The Head of Design, Development, & Construction will own the entire end to end process of launching new compounding pharmacies nationally. This will include site selection, feasibility, budgeting, design team & contractor selection, project management, build-out, and regulatory readiness of all Gilbert Pharmaceuticals pharmacy facilities. Reporting to the Director of Pharmacy Development & Operations, this role bridges pharmacy operations expertise with construction, facilities engineering, and regulatory compliance to bring new pharmacy sites from concept through licensure and go-live. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience designing and building efficient commercial spaces and pharmacy environments including traditional 503A compounding pharmacies and FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facilities operating under current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) Standards. Their thorough knowledge enables them to successfully navigate state and federal regulations required for pharmacy facility approval.

At Gilbert Pharmaceuticals , every role is AI-first. Work starts in an LLM to clarify intent and context, moves into the right tools to explore and execute, is tested with real users and stakeholders, and is continuously refined as we learn. AI and self-serve research are default parts of how we work, not side experiments.
We are looking for people who take full ownership of their work, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about building a company that meaningfully improves how healthcare is delivered.

We're Looking For

You think outside of the box, excel at creative problem-solving, and are comfortable taking on projects that you have potentially never done before! You are a people-person - empathetic, self-aware, low ego, and extremely positive - and are comfortable working in a small collaborative team where you'll wear many hats. You have care for performance, accessibility, and reliability as part of craft. You are passionate and proficient in written and verbal communication, and comfort pairing with designers, engineers, and marketers.

Key Responsibilities

Acquisition

  • Lead market analysis and site selection to identify viable pharmacy locations nationally.
  • Conduct feasibility assessments and due diligence on prospective sites, evaluating regulatory feasibility, build-out complexity, and operational suitability.
  • Develop and execute entitlement strategy for new pharmacy locations in coordination with legal and operations teams.
  • Act as liaison between landlords, brokers, and Gilbert Pharmaceuticals on your prospective sites.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to supply landlords and brokers with essential company information to secure new leases and site acquisitions.

Entitlements

  • Navigate land use and zoning requirements for each new pharmacy site.
  • Lead master plan coordination and manage environmental compliance obligations across all facility projects.
  • Oversee community outreach efforts and represent Gilbert Pharmaceuticals at public hearings as needed.
  • Coordinate regulatory submissions and interface directly with operations team on state Boards of Pharmacy, DEA, FDA, and local authorities for facility inspections and approvals.
  • Develop and maintain a facility compliance playbook for new site design and existing facility modifications.

Design

  • Lead concept and programming strategy for all new pharmacy facilities, translating operational workflows into effective, compliant physical environments.
  • Manage design team selection and coordination, including architects, MEP engineers, and specialty consultants.
  • Lead the architectural design and space planning for new pharmacy locations, including compounding suites, sterile and non-sterile areas, clean rooms, and dispensing environments.
  • Develop detailed facility design standards and specifications aligned with USP <795>, USP <797>, USP <800>, applicable state Board of Pharmacy requirements, and FDA cGMP requirements for 503B outsourcing facilities.
  • Review and approve architectural drawings, construction documents, and engineering plans for all new pharmacy projects.
  • Design scalable production environments for 503A and 503B operations, including batch manufacturing areas, quarantine/release zones, and controlled material flow segregation.
  • Develop HVAC, cleanroom, airflow, and environmental monitoring specifications in coordination with engineering and operating partners.
  • Coordinate with operating partners to ensure facility design supports validated processes, environmental monitoring programs, and batch production controls.

Pre-Con

  • Develop project budgets and oversee value engineering exercises to optimize cost without compromising regulatory or operational standards.
  • Lead GC selection processes, evaluating contractors for pharmacy build-out experience, compliance track record, and execution capability.
  • Manage permit management across all active projects, ensuring timely approvals from local building authorities and regulatory bodies.
  • Develop and track project timelines, procurement schedules, and risk mitigation plans across multiple concurrent site developments.

Construction

  • Serve as Owner's representative throughout construction, maintaining accountability for design intent, budget, and schedule.
  • Provide field oversight through regular site inspections and quality walkthroughs to ensure regulatory and operational standards are met.
  • Maintain rigorous cost control across all active build-outs, managing change orders and contractor performance.
  • Oversee FF&E installation and commissioning of all pharmacy-specific equipment and systems.
  • Manage QA & closeout activities including installation qualifications of critical manufacturing utilities (e.g., WFI systems, clean steam, environmental monitoring) where applicable to 503A and 503B facilities.
  • Drive operational readiness in partnership with pharmacy operations and quality teams, ensuring facilities are inspection-ready as soon as possible.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation including as-built drawings, equipment lists, and SOPs for all facility environments.
  • Support evaluation of pharmacy partners by assessing the design and regulatory readiness of their existing facilities.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering (Mechanical, Civil, or Chemical), Pharmacy, or a closely related field; advanced degree or licensure preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience designing, building, or commissioning pharmacy facilities, healthcare environments, or regulated laboratory/cleanroom spaces.
  • Ability to understand/learn USP <795>, USP <797>, USP <800>, and applicable state Board of Pharmacy facility requirements.
  • Demonstrated project management experience overseeing construction projects from design through commissioning.
  • Experience interfacing with regulatory agencies on facility approvals and inspections.
  • Proficiency with architectural drawings, construction documents, and facility engineering specifications.
  • Experience designing or supporting sterile manufacturing or 503B outsourcing facilities operating under cGMP environments strongly preferred.
  • Ability to travel to pharmacy sites as needed for construction oversight, inspections, and go-live support.

raw.title: Principal Solutions Architect
raw.description:
Headquarters: Remote

You know a great technical sale is about more than delivering a polished demo. The real work is understanding what a customer is trying to accomplish, figuring out whether Expel can actually solve it, and making sure what we promise during the sales process is exactly what our teams are prepared to deliver.

As a Principal Solutions Architect at Expel, you'll own the technical side of some of our most complex Enterprise opportunities. You'll lead technical discovery, demonstrate Expel's service, design and drive Proofs of Value (POVs), work through technical objections, and create the bridge between Sales and Delivery so customers aren't starting over once the deal is signed.

You'll need enough technical depth to comfortably navigate conversations across security operations, incident response, SIEM, endpoint, network, and cloud environments. But being the smartest technical person in the room isn't enough. We're looking for someone who can listen, ask great questions, tell a compelling technical story, challenge assumptions when necessary, and build trust with everyone from a SOC analyst to a CISO.

This is a Principal-level individual contributor role. You'll be expected to independently navigate our hardest opportunities, influence people who don't report to you, hold teams accountable when necessary, and help make the broader Solutions Architecture organization better along the way.

Sound like your kind of challenge? We'd like to hear from you.

What Expel can do for you

  • Put you at the center of complex Enterprise security opportunities where your technical judgment can directly influence both the sale and the long-term customer relationship.
  • Give you ownership across the technical sales lifecycle, from discovery and demos through POVs, technical objections, escalations, and the transition into service delivery.
  • Expose you to a wide range of Enterprise security environments across SIEM, endpoint, network, cloud, identity, security operations, and detection and response.
  • Connect you with experienced Account Executives, Sales leaders, SOC analysts, Detection & Response, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Service Delivery teams.
  • Give you the autonomy to solve difficult customer problems creatively while maintaining the integrity to be clear about what Expel can and cannot do.
  • Give you the opportunity to influence how we run POVs, approach Enterprise opportunities, transition customers into delivery, and improve the overall Solutions Architecture motion.
  • Let you remain deeply connected to customers and technical work while operating with Principal-level visibility and influence across the business.

What you can do for Expel

  • Own the technical strategy for complex Enterprise opportunities from initial discovery through POV, onboarding, and the customer's first 30 days.
  • Lead POVs end to end by defining meaningful success criteria, building the technical delivery plan, coordinating internal teams, troubleshooting issues, and keeping execution on track.
  • Deeply understand the challenges bringing a prospect to Expel and clearly map those needs to what our service can and cannot solve.
  • Deliver technical service demonstrations and tell a compelling story about how Expel creates security value, adapting your approach based on whether you're speaking with practitioners, executives, or somewhere in between.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor who can ask difficult questions, challenge assumptions, navigate technical objections, and tell a prospect or salesperson "no" when that's the right answer.
  • Partner closely with Account Executives and regional Sales leadership on opportunity strategy, technical discovery, competitive positioning, RFPs/RFIs, and complex customer requirements.
  • Prepare Delivery teams with the technical context, expectations, risks, environment details, and opportunities necessary for a smooth transition from pre-sales into service delivery.
  • Own technical escalations that arise during POVs or the first 30 days of service, pulling together the right people and staying accountable until the issue reaches resolution.
  • Coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, SOC, Detection & Response, Customer Success, and Delivery, influencing and holding stakeholders accountable even when they don't report to you.
  • Maintain strong working knowledge across SIEM, endpoint/EDR, network, cloud, security operations, incident response, attacker behavior, and detection and response.
  • Identify opportunities to improve our POV methodology, technical content, processes, customer handoffs, and internal enablement, then work across teams to actually implement those improvements.
  • Raise the technical and consultative bar for the broader Solutions Architecture team by sharing what you learn and helping others navigate difficult customer and technical situations.

What you should bring with you

  • 8+ years of relevant experience across Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, technical security selling, security consulting, security operations, incident response, or similar customer-facing security roles.
  • A track record of operating at a senior or principal level, regardless of your current title. You can independently own complex Enterprise opportunities, influence stakeholders without formal authority, and become the technical person others trust when the answer isn't obvious.
  • Meaningful experience leading complex Enterprise POVs, including technical discovery, defining success criteria, coordinating execution, managing objections, troubleshooting issues, and connecting technical outcomes back to customer goals.
  • Strong security depth with the ability to confidently discuss security operations, incident response, attacker behavior, network architecture, cloud environments, SIEM, endpoint/EDR, and detection and response.
  • The ability to understand how security technologies work together in real customer environments and identify where technology alone doesn't solve the underlying problem.
  • Strong storytelling skills. You can take something technically complicated and make it understandable, relevant, and compelling for a SOC analyst, security engineer, Account Executive, or CISO.
  • Trusted-advisor instincts. You look beyond what a customer initially asks for, uncover what they're actually trying to accomplish, and aren't afraid to respectfully challenge a proposed approach.
  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills with experience coordinating complex work and holding others accountable without relying on formal authority.
  • High EQ and the ability to navigate disagreement, conflicting priorities, and difficult customer conversations without losing trust.
  • Genuine curiosity. You ask thoughtful questions, dig beyond surface-level answers, and continuously invest in understanding security, technology, customers, and the business.
  • Coachability and a low-ego approach to feedback. You don't need to know everything, but you should want to keep getting better.
  • A track record of improving processes, technical strategy, enablement, customer deliverables, or team practices beyond your own individual opportunities.

Bonus points for...

  • Hands-on experience working in a SOC, incident response, threat hunting, detection engineering, or another security operations environment.
  • Experience selling or delivering MDR, MSSP, SIEM, EDR/XDR, cloud security, or other security operations solutions.
  • Experience supporting large Enterprise customers with complex environments, long sales cycles, and multiple technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Experience working directly with Delivery or Customer Success after the sale rather than ending your involvement when the contract is signed.
  • Experience responding to complex Enterprise RFPs and RFIs.
  • Experience improving POV methodology, technical enablement, reusable content, or processes for a broader Solutions Architecture or Sales Engineering organization.
  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related discipline.

Additional notes

This role is remote within the United States. While our office is located in Herndon, Virginia, we're open to candidates across the U.S. who can effectively support the customers, Account Executives, and regional stakeholders aligned to their territory.

Travel is expected to be up to 10-20% and may include customer meetings, executive briefings, conferences, roadshows, and visits to Expel HQ.

The targeted base salary range for this role is $186,000 to $195,000 USD, with a 75/25 pay mix resulting in targeted on-track earnings (OTE) of $248,000 to $260,000 USD, plus equity.

We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your compensation will ultimately be based on factors such as your experience, skills, team equity, and market data. You'll also be eligible for unlimited PTO, which we model and encourage, work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.

We're only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

We're an Equal Opportunity Employer: You'll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

We'll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.

#LI-remote

$186,000—$195,000 USD

raw.title: Business Development & Growth Associate, Pharma
raw.description:

At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for a Business Development & Growth Associate, Pharma to join our Wisdo Health team. This role would be responsible for supporting the continued growth of our pharma business. Working directly with Wisdo’s President, this person will play a hands-on role in identifying prospective clients, executing outreach campaigns, supporting business-development activities, and helping expand relationships across the pharmaceutical industry. This role is ideal for someone who is resourceful, technology-savvy, and comfortable using AI and a variety of digital tools to work quickly and independently. You may be researching a pharmaceutical brand and building a prospect list, launching a LinkedIn campaign, preparing for a client meeting, working in our CRM, or using AI to accelerate research and content development. Prospecting, outreach, and consistent follow-up are central to the role. You’ll also help turn what you learn about prospective clients into stronger campaigns and sales materials. The right person enjoys figuring things out, learning new tools, and turning ideas into execution. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position based on Eastern Time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

What You’ll Do

  • Prospecting & Outreach
    • Research pharmaceutical companies, brands, therapeutic areas, agencies, and potential partners.
    • Identify decision-makers and build and maintain targeted prospect and account lists.
    • Use LinkedIn, prospecting databases, AI tools, and other resources to identify contacts and opportunities.
    • Build and execute targeted email and LinkedIn outreach campaigns.
    • Conduct initial outreach, personalize communications, and manage systematic follow-up.
    • Track responses and help turn initial interest into meetings with senior leadership.
  • Sales & Pipeline Support
    • Maintain prospect, opportunity, and activity information in the CRM and track follow-ups and next steps.
    • Research companies, brands, and attendees in advance of prospective-client meetings.
    • Help customize presentations and prepare materials for client conversations.
    • Coordinate post-meeting follow-up and support proposals, RFP responses, and other business-development materials.
  • AI, Data & Commercial Tools
    • Use AI extensively to accelerate prospect research, account intelligence, outreach, meeting preparation, and content development.
    • Work hands-on across CRM platforms, prospecting databases, LinkedIn, email and marketing platforms, spreadsheets, presentation tools, and other commercial technologies.
    • Explore new AI and automation tools and identify opportunities to make prospecting, outreach, and other workflows more efficient.
    • Learn new platforms independently and maintain clean, organized data across systems.
  • Growth Marketing & Events
    • Help execute campaigns around Wisdo research, client results, white papers, webinars, and thought leadership.
    • Support LinkedIn, email, and other marketing activities targeting pharmaceutical audiences.
    • Research relevant conferences and events, identify priority prospects and attendees, and coordinate pre- and post-event outreach.
    • Help develop and maintain sales and marketing materials.

About You 

  • At least 3 years of hands-on business development or growth experience in healthcare, life sciences, or healthcare marketing, including prospect research, outbound outreach, and pipeline follow-up.
  • Experience targeting pharmaceutical brands, patient support teams, or healthcare/pharma agencies is strongly preferred.
  • Able to describe outreach campaigns you personally executed and the meetings or opportunities they generated.
  • Hands-on experience using a CRM, prospecting tools, LinkedIn, and email platforms to run outreach and maintain an organized pipeline. 
  • Strong research and writing skills, with demonstrated use of AI tools to work faster while checking the accuracy and quality of the output.

Benefits 

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans
  • Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA
  • 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 4%
  • Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.
  • Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care
  • Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment
  • Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events
  • Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount! 

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $67,000 - $95,0000. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications. 

Why Talkspace? 

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. raw.title: Principal Technical Product Marketing Manager
raw.description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. 

 

Principal Technical Product Marketing Manager – Foundation Pillar

Team: Product Marketing
Reports to: VP, Product Marketing

About the Role

6sense is the GTM Intelligence Platform, and Foundation is the layer the rest of it stands on — "platform, data, infrastructure: the backbone everything builds on." It owns account and people data, matching and identity, the APIs and MCP framework, security and connectors, signal publication, and the workflows that move data through the system. When buyers ask whether 6sense is accurate, extensible, secure, and composable, the answer lives here.

We're looking for a Principal Technical Product Marketing Manager to own positioning, messaging, and go-to-market for the Foundation pillar. This is the most technical seat on the PMM team. You'll translate deep capabilities — identity resolution, data coverage and accuracy, API extensibility, the MCP framework, security and compliance — into differentiated stories that win over the technical and economic buyers who scrutinize them: RevOps architects, IT and security teams, data leaders, and increasingly developers building agentic GTM stacks.

You'll also carry one of the most strategically important narratives in the company: that 6sense is a composable intelligence layer other systems and AI agents plug into — "AI to the data, not data to the AI" — rather than a closed destination. With the MCP framework moving to GA, this is a present-tense story, and you'll be the one who tells it credibly.

What You'll Own

  • Positioning and messaging for the Foundation pillar — platform, data, infrastructure, identity and matching, APIs and the MCP framework, security and connectors, signal publication, and workflows. You set the narrative and keep it coherent with the Intelligence and Activation pillars.
  • Technical proof. Turn capability into credibility: architecture explainers, technical briefs and whitepapers, benchmarks, and reference narratives that substantiate the "backbone everything builds on" claim — especially around data accuracy, coverage, and identity resolution.
  • The composable / MCP-agent story. Own the infrastructure-layer narrative — 6sense as the data and intelligence layer that agentic GTM stacks compose with. Lead GTM for the MCP framework and the developer / technical-buyer audience it opens up.
  • Differentiation for the data and identity layer. Make the case against point data providers and infrastructure alternatives — coverage, match rates, identity quality, enrichment, security posture — and arm the field to win on it.
  • Field and partner enablement for technical evaluations. Build the battlecards, objection handling, FAQs, and solution content that win RFPs, security reviews, and technical POCs. Partner with Sales Engineering to make the technical buyer's diligence a place 6sense wins.
  • Launches. Drive end-to-end GTM for Foundation releases: new data assets, API and MCP capabilities, security packages (SCIM, SSO role mapping, audit, custom roles), connectors, and workflow features.
  • Cross-functional partnership. Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the Foundation Product and Engineering leaders to shape roadmap-to-market, and with Customer Success to surface the post-sale and admin/security use cases that prove the platform's breadth.
  • Market and competitive intelligence for the data and platform layer, feeding insight back into roadmap and pricing/packaging conversations.

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years in product marketing, technical product management, or a closely related function, with substantial technical PMM experience for platform, data, infrastructure, API, or developer products.
  • A proven ability to translate technical concepts — APIs, data pipelines, identity resolution, integrations, security, and AI/agent architectures like MCP — into crisp positioning and business value, without losing the engineers in the room or the buyers outside it.
  • A track record owning messaging for technical products and enabling technical sales motions (Sales Engineering, RFPs, security reviews, POCs).
  • Hands-on, not hand-wavy. You'll personally call the APIs, stand up and configure the MCP server, connect it to an agent, and build the demo — and your messaging is sharper because you've done the thing, not just read the spec.
  • Strong writing — you can produce content that is technically rigorous and genuinely clear, from a one-line value prop to an architecture whitepaper.
  • Fluency with the B2B SaaS buyer, ideally in martech, RevTech, or data platforms, and comfort selling to technical and economic buyers (RevOps architects, IT, security, data teams, developers).
  • The judgment and presence to operate as a senior individual contributor: set strategy, lead cross-functionally without authority, and influence product and executive stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on familiarity with data enrichment and identity (waterfall enrichment, matching, intent data), MCP and agentic AI architectures, or composable/API-first platforms.
  • Experience marketing to developers or technical evaluators, including documentation-adjacent and developer-community work.
  • Background in or adjacent to GTM intelligence, ABM, sales intelligence, CDP, iPaaS, or identity platforms.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6–12 months, Foundation has a differentiated, defensible position that technical buyers recognize; the composable/MCP infrastructure story is landed with the field and the market as something that exists today, not a roadmap promise; the data and identity credibility story is substantiated with proof, not assertion; and the field has the enablement to win the technical evaluation every time it comes.

 

Base Salary Range: $183,044.00 - $205,035. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). #Li-remote

Notice of Collection and Use of Personal Information for California Residents: California Recruitment Privacy Notice and Policy

Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces. 

We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.

Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity? 

Are you ready to lead the charge in AI-driven customer service? As an Enterprise Account Executive focused on selling Fin, our cutting-edge AI agent, you’ll play a pivotal role in revolutionizing how enterprises scale customer support. Fin leverages advanced artificial intelligence to deliver seamless, efficient, and intelligent support experiences, making it a game-changer for businesses worldwide.

This is your chance to join a world-class sales team, driving the upmarket growth of a transformative AI solution. At Fin, we don’t just sell products; we empower businesses to reimagine their customer support strategies. If you’re looking for ownership, creativity, and the opportunity to lead in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.

What will I be doing?

  • Full-cycle sales ownership: Manage the entire sales process—from prospecting to close—with a consultative and tailored approach.

All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE).

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Knock is redefining the home buying and selling experience, and we’re only getting started! We’re a passionate team of industry experts who knew there had to be a better, simpler way for people to navigate the journey between homes. That people-first mindset is core to how we operate, and why Knock has been honored as one of Inc.’s Best Workplaces six times in the past seven years.

We bring that mindset into the work we do every day.  The Knock Bridge Loan™ empowers homebuyers to ‘buy before they sell’, by unlocking the equity in their current home, giving them greater convenience, certainty, and competitiveness. 

Founded in 2015, Knock has grown into a trusted partner for thousands of homebuyers and a network of 60,000+ loan officers and agents across the country. Backed by top investors like Foundry Group, Trinity Capital, and the National Association of Realtors, we’ve built a reputation for innovation and trust, earning 900+ five-star Zillow and Trustpilot reviews and an A+ BBB rating. 

Join our growing team and help shape the future of homebuying! To learn more, visit Knock.com

Director of Sales, Account Executive Team – Remote, anywhere in the US

About the Role

Knock is looking for a proven sales leader to own the performance and growth of Knock's Account Executive organization. You will be accountable for delivering the company plan for leads and loan applications across Account Executives, Senior Account Executives, and Wholesale Account Executives.

Knock originates the Knock Bridge Loan™, which enables homeowners to use the money tied up in their current home to purchase their next one — buy before you sell. You will choose the partner segments worth pursuing, set the coverage model, own the positioning against every alternative in the market, and sharpen the team that delivers the volume.

What You'll Do

  • Own the AE organization's number — outreach activity, leads, conversion, and loan application volume against the company plan
  • Set and defend the team's production standards, and revisit them as the lead mix and product set evolve
  • Hire, develop, coach, and hold accountable the Account Executive team
  • Own AE onboarding and ramp as a repeatable program with measurable time-to-productivity
  • Own org design and the territory and coverage model, and build the AE headcount plan with Finance
  • Maintain distinct playbooks for retail lending partners and for the broader lender and agent set, rather than forcing a single motion across both
  • Design and evaluate AE compensation plans in partnership with the People team and Finance, grounded in applications generated and modeled against cost of sale
  • Deliver an accurate rolling forecast to the leadership team, and run the pipeline and forecast cadence behind it
  • Serve as the company's subject matter expert on the Account Executive channel — turning partner and borrower feedback into product, marketing, and lending operations changes, and driving adoption of those changes in the field

What You'll Bring

  • Experience: Minimum of 8 years of sales or business development experience in mortgage, real estate, or proptech, including at least 4 years leading sales teams
  • Track record of hiring, coaching, and developing sellers into consistent performers
  • Demonstrated ownership of a sales number, with a track record of growing lead and application volume while forecasting accurately against plan
  • Deep understanding of how to sell into retail lending — how loan officers, team leads, and branch managers make decisions, and what moves them: closing clients stuck in the process, excluding the departing property from DTI, and winning offers with no home sale contingency — and the ability to turn that into the playbooks, training, and coaching the team runs on
  • Ability to set the positioning strategy for a Buy Before You Sell product — including the case to lenders that Knock is a bridge to a mortgage they retain — and how the team handles cost, rate, and timing objections from both the lending partner and the borrower
  • Command of the competitive landscape, with the judgment to keep Knock's positioning ahead of the alternatives and to equip the team to sell against them
  • Experience designing or materially influencing sales compensation plans that drive the right selling behavior
  • Strong analytical judgment — comfortable building the model, reading the data, and acting on what it says
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to brief leadership and represent Knock externally to partners
  • A deep belief in fostering inclusive, equitable practices that reflect Knock's core values
  • Proven success in a fully remote, distributed team environment
  • Recent lending experience required
  • Education: Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent experience

We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every listed qualification. We value potential, growth mindset, and diverse experiences.

Physical Requirements

  • Set up and constantly operate a computer.
  • Communicate and exchange accurate information to others via telephone or internet video applications.
  • Must be able to travel, including overnight travel at least 4 times per year 
  • Must be able to lift, carry and push up to 20 lbs.

The candidate must be able to perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Compensation

Our Compensation Philosophy: As a fully remote (U.S.-based) workforce, our goal is to ensure that all Knockstars are fairly compensated. The compensation information below is a good faith estimate for this position and is provided in accordance with applicable state and local pay transparency laws.

The salary range estimate for this position is: $165,000.00 - $180,000.00 USD. This role is also eligible for a bonus based on achievement of plan metrics. Actual earnings may vary based on individual performance.

This job posting will expire on October 30, 2026.

Offer & Employment Terms

The actual offer, reflecting the total compensation package & benefits, will be at the company’s sole discretion, and determined by factors including but not limited to years of experience, job level, geographic location, and other relevant business considerations. The company also reserves the right to amend or modify this job description, employee perks, and benefits at any time. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can translate complex technical capability into compelling, credible narratives — and who's comfortable in the room with engineers as much as with executives. You'll own the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing at a stage where positioning decisions have outsized impact on growth.

You will guide a talented team, focusing on sales enablement, website conversion, feature adoption, and Storyblok’s market positioning with industry analysts and customer review platforms. A key responsibility is to elevate our product marketing function to influence revenue, customer acquisition, and market leadership.

Your mission is to enable Storyblok to win in the market by clearly articulating our value, differentiation, and future direction.

What you’ll bring:

You're genuinely comfortable operating in technical territory, not just translating it secondhand. You can read API documentation, understand headless CMS architecture, and hold a credible, detailed conversation with engineers and technical evaluators about how the product actually works — its components, integration points, and trade-offs versus alternative approaches. This fluency shows up in the quality of your messaging: you write positioning that developers trust because it's accurate, not just persuasive. 

You've likely worked hands-on with developers before, whether as a technical product marketer, solutions engineer, technical product manager, or in an engineering-adjacent role, and you know how to earn credibility with a technical audience rather than assume it.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Product Positioning & Messaging

  • Own and evolve our core messaging and differentiated value proposition across all audiences (developers, marketers, partners, enterprise buyers), setting the strategic framework the wider team executes against
  • Direct ongoing customer, market, and competitive research programs to ensure messaging stays relevant, differentiated, and current
  • Set the standard for translating product capabilities and roadmap into solution-oriented, benefits-led messaging that resonates across the buyer journey
  • Ensure messaging consistency and governance across all channels — website, campaigns, sales assets, analyst briefings, and customer communications

Go-To-Market Strategy & Execution

  • Own GTM strategy for major product and feature launches, driving alignment across Product, Growth, Sales, Customer Success, and Content leadership

Analyst & Review Site Strategy

  • Define and lead the analyst relations strategy to secure meaningful participation in key analyst evaluations (e.g., Gartner Magic Quadrant, Forrester Wave, IDC MarketScape).
  • Orchestrate analyst briefing cycles, submission processes, and relationships that enhance Storyblok’s visibility and influence.
  • Own our presence and growth strategy on review platforms (G2, Gartner Peer Insights), including review acquisition and profile optimization
  • Establish ongoing monitoring and response mechanisms for public reviews and rankings

Website & CRO Performance

  • Set priorities for CRO initiatives that improve engagement, conversion, and self-serve funnel performance
  • Define messaging strategy and success metrics for key product pages, feature highlights, and trial flows

Lead, mentor, and inspire the Product Marketing team to deliver high-impact outcomes aligned with company goals.

  • Set team structure, priorities, and ways of working in partnership with marketing leadership
  • Coach the team on messaging craft, technical fluency, and cross-functional collaboration
  • Foster a culture of ownership, curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning.
  • Develop individual growth plans, conduct regular performance reviews, and ensure team members have access to relevant coaching and training opportunities.
  • Ensure strong collaboration across Product, Growth, Brand, and Sales teams to drive alignment and accountability.

 

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • 8+ years of experience in Product Marketing, with at least 2+ years in a leadership role.

  • Strong understanding of PLG motions, SaaS business models, and the product lifecycle.

At OnTheGoSystems, the company behind WPML, Toolset, and PTC, we’re looking for a hands-on, AI-native marketer who wants to take ownership of marketing and help shape how we do it.

AI is a core part of how we work. We’re looking for someone who already uses AI agents, automation, integrations, and structured workflows to get real marketing work done – and can show us what they’ve achieved with them.

This is also a technical role. We’ve built our own analytics, newsletter, and marketing automation systems, so you should be comfortable working with technical tools, setting up a local development environment, and using tools like Claude to help you navigate technical tasks.

You won’t be joining an established marketing team or following a fixed playbook. You’ll have the freedom to talk to our clients, understand our business, find the strongest opportunities, and decide what marketing should focus on next.

What You’ll Work On

Several areas currently need an owner:

  • SEO / GEO / AEO

  • Content and collaborations with partners, authors, and bloggers

  • Marketing to existing customers, including retention and expansion

  • Paid advertising

  • Client analytics

  • Other marketing opportunities you identify

You’ll work hands-on, from identifying an opportunity through execution, measurement, and improvement.

Your First Weeks

We don’t expect you to arrive with all the answers. We want you to understand the business first and then decide what should be done.

You’ll:

  • Learn our products, industry, competitors, and ecosystem.

  • Speak directly with customers to understand their needs and how they see our products.

  • Look at our data, existing activities, and opportunities.

  • Identify where marketing can have the biggest impact.

  • Build a concrete plan for the areas you propose to own and explain why.

What We’re Looking For

  • You already use AI agents, automation, and advanced AI workflows in your everyday work and can show us concrete results.

  • You’re hands-on and comfortable with the technical side of marketing.

  • You’re curious and take time to understand customers and the business before proposing solutions.

  • You can work across different areas of marketing and turn ideas into action.

  • You understand how marketing connects to business results.

  • You have experience marketing technical products, ideally software, SaaS, WordPress, or similar.

  • You work independently and can move things forward without detailed instructions.

  • You’re comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change and not everything is defined in advance.

Why Join Us

OnTheGoSystems is a profitable, self-funded product company growing since 2007. WPML powers more than 1.5 million websites worldwide.

You’ll have real ownership and the freedom to help build our marketing approach, work directly with our CEO and product teams, experiment with AI, and turn your ideas into real marketing initiatives.

We care about the people we work with and want to support them beyond their day-to-day work. Along with the flexibility of working remotely, we offer perks and benefits that support both work and life.

If you’re excited about building marketing with AI, getting hands-on, and having the freedom to shape what comes next, we’d love to hear from you.
